name: Wraithguard
enchantment: Protects the bearer from the power of the Heart of Lorkhan
description: One of the Tools of Kagrenac — the gauntlet that alone allows Sunder and Keening to be safely wielded against the Heart.
lore: Forged by the dwemer Kagrenac to tap the divine, it scarred the hand of the Nerevarine forever.

name: Sunder
description: Kagrenac's hammer, made to sunder the divine from the mortal.
lore: Torn from a dwemer vault beneath Red Mountain and returned there by the Nerevarine.

name: Keening
description: Kagrenac's dagger, the razor that drew the divine from the Heart.
lore: With Wraithguard and Sunder it made the Tribunal gods — and unmade the dwemer.

name: Boots of Blinding Speed
enchantment: Fortify Speed 200pts for 30s — but blinds the wearer
description: Phemic Enabler's famed boots: run faster than the wind, and see nothing.
lore: Found in the smuggler warrens beneath the West Gash; a lesson in reading enchantments before wearing them.

name: Amulet of Shadows
description: An amulet that veils the wearer in shadow, all but vanishing from sight.
lore: A relic of the Morag Tong, equally useful to thieves and to those fleeing them.

name: Ebony Mail
enchantment: Constant chameleon while sneaking; poison resistance
description: The artifact armor of Boethiah, worn by the Champion of the Plague Lord.
lore: Its wearer moves unseen in shadow and poison slides off like rain.

name: Trueflame
description: The sacred blade of Indoril Nerevar, reforged in the fires of Mournhold.
lore: Twin to Hopesfire; together they were Nerevar's honor, taken up again by his inheritor.
